_comment: Combat Lab scenario role labels (PROJ-278). Used for wiring ships into scenario test scaffolds via the ships_by_role dict. Static — players don't write Combat Lab scenarios so this registry is read-only at runtime. Adding a new template that references a new role label requires adding it here AND will trigger the consistency test.
